programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am

programme.title: Jamil Balik Kampung
programme.desc: Kisah perjalanan Jamil pulang ke kampung untuk meminang kekasihnya setelah pinangannya pernah ditolak beberapa kali. Berjayakah misi Jamil kali ini?

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta
programme.desc: Kupid Cubit is a dating app that enables the masses to find love. But for Katarina and Saiful, its a platform for healing people with unrequited love.

programme.title: Duit Kawin
programme.desc: Memaparkan pemikiran remaja sekarang terhadap perkahwinan dari sudut kos atas syariat agama tetapi tertekan cara hidup zaman kini yang mahukan kemewahan.

programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi
programme.desc: Kisah penulis lagu Maya Arisa yang menghidap tumor otak dan mengimpikan untuk berkahwin. Dia kemudiannya bertemu dengan seorang jurugambar bernama Redza.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Cinta Round 1
programme.desc: Farid is a nerdy guy who always been bullied by Syakirin, his senior. Farid determined to enter an MMA tournament organized by their university so to put an end to being bullied by Syakirin.

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam
programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.title: Please Subscribe Cintaku
programme.desc: Hannah and her friend Alia have gone to an abandoned construction site to find material for her YouTube channel, but she unknowingly records a murder.

programme.title: Diva Dari Jakarta
programme.desc: Erin dan Ejot sering dibandingkan dari segi paras rupa. Sehingga suatu hari sesuatu telah berlaku kepada Erin yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat baik yang berhadapan dengan konflik perhubungan di saat mereka mula panik memikirkan usia mereka yang semakin meningkat tetapi belum bertemu jodoh.

programme.title: Nasiya
programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.desc: Ani, the most beautiful girl in the village, who is ever mans fantasy, decides to marry Mr. Bear as her husband, much to everyones surprise. As for the chief village, he intend to organise the wedding of the year.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Hayes Hodges, an attorney, takes up the offer of defending his friend Colonel Terry Childers, accused of ordering his squad to open fire on a group of demonstrators.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: No information available

programme.title: The Commando
programme.desc: A DEA agent returns home with PTSD after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion when a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions hidden inside of the agents home.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: A Las Vegas casino magnate, determined to find a new avenue for wagering, sets up a race for money.

programme.title: Mayfair - Shooting Paul
programme.desc: Hoping to put the past behind him and go legit, Max is persuaded by Paul to open a new Mister Mayfair club in Portugal. Conflict, however, seems to follow Max wherever he goes. Drawn into a violent turf war between London Gangsters and the Italian Mafia, his relationship with Ava is jeopardised by the arrival of his former flame, Serena. Max’s carefully crafted world seems to be collapsing around him. With his family’s lives on the line, Max is blackmailed by British crime boss, Tommy, to assassinate his best friend, Paul.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serenas Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: No information available

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor’s life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: Crom
programme.desc: High school teenagers accidentally unleash an ancient Irish entity on their hometown and must stop it before midnight on Halloween.

programme.title: Johnny And Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alanas casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page, a brilliant mother-daughter swindler team, target the citys wealthiest men. Max marries them and then sues for alimony after she catches them involved in an affair with Page.

programme.title: The Legion
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: High Voltage
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Project Legion
programme.desc: A young man trapped in his apartment with a swarm of demons outside his door must find a way to survive the night and escape from apartment 213.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: A female FBI agent is offered millions to help a thief escape from a hijacked airplane.

programme.title: Broken Star
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: During WWII, the American army have raced their way through the countryside on the border of France entering Nazi Germany. Hitler has deployed his secret weapon. Lieutenant Frank Ross encounters the Nazi weapon and an intense aerial battle ensues.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: Two dangerous armed men must hunt each other and fight to death over millions of dollars in cash in this high octane wilderness survival story.

Sing about friendship, play a game of Red Light, Green Light, and have a Copy Me style dance-off on the playground. Its party time!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Get ready for some cupcake chaos! Lulu wants to bake a cupcake by herself, but when she doesnt follow the recipe, it turns into a giant, out-of-control blob! She also finds a colorful egg that hatches into a cute chick, but she has to let it go back to its mommy. The friends paint a big picture together, but Newt wants it all for herself.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Its no fun being a spoilsport! Fuse finds a spider in his gym and is too scared to get it out. Jeff and Bubbles are having trouble playing with their building blocks together. Bubbles spoils Pogos magic show by exposing all his secrets and Lulu struggles to make a music video when her star Oddbird keeps marching away.

programme.title: Geckos Garage
programme.desc: Baby Truck is always ready for an adventure, and today hes leading his friends on an exciting exploration! Their playtime takes a messy turn when Baby Trucks curiosity gets the better of him, and he ends up stuck deep in the mud. It looks like hes in real trouble, but his friends wont leave him behind. This is a wonderful tale of how the smallest heroes, working together as a team, can solve even the stickiest of problems.

programme.title: Geckos Garage
programme.desc: Get ready for fun and play at the garage! Weasel gets carried away by his own advertising blimp and Gecko has to rescue him with a bouncy castle. The team takes an imaginary trip to outer space and modifies Baby Truck into a rocket. They turn a fire hose into a wacky waterslide to cool off on a hot day and have a baby race with a pit stop.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Get ready for a farming sing-along! When Ella is feeling anxious, she does the five senses shakedown to feel better. She and Rishi play a game of I Hear With My Little Ear to find all the animals on the farm. Do the ABC dance, go stargazing with Grandma Mei and take care of five mischievous monkeys. Plus, learn that its okay to make mistakes and that tidying up can be fun.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Its time to explore Earth and nature! A frog ballerina shows Ella that rain can be fun and is important for the farm. The friends celebrate Earth Day by litter picking and composting. When some of the animals get sick, Ella helps the vet at a makeshift animal hospital. Plus, watch a caterpillar turn into a butterfly and learn some yoga moves with Rishis mom.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Its song and dance time! Join JJ, his friends and family celebrating lifes big moments for little kids. Come along and be part of their fun everyday adventures.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ on a magical carousel ride where his imagination turns him into a brave knight! When hes feeling scared, Dad helps him blast off in a pretend rocketship. Build an amazing maze for Jellybean the hamster, put on sunscreen at the beach and play a fun game of Peek-a-Boo. Then, become a detective and help solve the mystery of who took the cookies from the cookie jar!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: On your marks, get set, go! Its a day of fun and friendly competition. Join JJ and his friends as they head outside for a sports day. Theyll splash in the pool, kick a soccer ball on the field, and learn that the most important part of any game is having fun and trying your best.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Its Little Angel! Where baby John, his brother, Jack, and sister, Jill inspire kids and families to have fun and to grow and learn through play. Come sing along!

programme.title: Little Angel

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: The animal kingdom is a wonderful place! Join Blippi Wonders as he learns about creatures of all shapes and sizes. He discovers how a caterpillar turns into a butterfly, why a camel has a hump, and what makes a whale so big. From the jungle to the farm, its an animal adventure full of fun and fascinating facts.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Get ready to explore planet Earth with Blippi Wonders! This series of adventures delves into the science of our world. Learn about how trees grow, what makes a volcano erupt, and why some things sink while others float. With the help of his trusty friends, Blippi makes learning about nature and science an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Join Arpo as he tries to keep the house in order, a task thats easier said than done with Baby Daniel around! Whether its tackling a mountain of dishes, dealing with a misbehaving vacuum, or chasing a mischievous squirrel, Arpos day is never dull. This is a story of household adventures and the funny side of chores.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Prepare for pandemonium! Arpo and Daniels attempt at gardening takes a dangerous turn when their plant grows into a monstrous creature that tries to eat everyone. As if thats not enough, the new smart house system goes haywire, and the furniture starts a rebellion. Its up to Arpo to fix the pandemonium in this action-packed adventure.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Its song and dance time! Join JJ, his friends and family celebrating lifes big moments for little kids. Come along and be part of their fun everyday adventures.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Whats on the menu today? Fun! Join JJ as he learns why its great to eat vegetables with the Yes Yes Vegetables song. Then, get your hands ready for a fun time in the kitchen as he sings and claps along to Pat-a-Cake. Its a delicious and musical tale about our favorite foods.

programme.title: CoComelon

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: The skies over Petport are full of trouble! A giant UFO with a massive claw is stealing things from the city, creating panic. As Mila and Morphle fly up to stop it, they find themselves in even more trouble when the mischievous Orphle appears on a magical cloud, adding to the aerial mayhem. Its a high-flying adventure as they try to dodge two threats and save the citys stolen property.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: When things go missing and mysteries arise, Detective Mila is on the case! With her ever-reliable partner Morphle, shes ready to solve any puzzle. Morphle transforms into all the tools a good detective needs-a magnifying glass to find clues, a key to unlock secrets, and a cage to trap the culprit-in this exciting and magical mystery adventure.

programme.title: Rob the Robot
programme.desc: Get ready for an adventure in lost and found! When Ema cant find her favorite moon boots, the crew departs for the Lost and Found Planet, but its not long before they all get lost in the maze of items. After finding their way out, they want to fly Orbits new kites, but they get to the Windy Planet and discover there is no wind!

programme.title: Rob the Robot
programme.desc: Theres color confusion when Orbit accidentally paints himself pink and the crew must travel to the Paint Planet to change him back to normal. Then, the gang gets ready for the Intergalactic Space-A-Lympics, but Orbit isnt excited because hes terrible at sports!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Its time to learn about numbers, sounds and colors! The friends fly colorful fish kites at the park and bake some yummy cookies. They play with five little speckled frogs and five little green monster bottles. They learn about all the sounds that different vehicles make, how to say hello with a wave and what sounds different instruments make.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for Mias spectacular sing-along! She and her friends see five little speckled frogs at the pond. The big bus gets all muddy and the friends have to work together to get it clean. They go on a fun train ride and Mia has to get her favorite bunny clean after it gets all muddy. Plus, learn about shapes, names and what to do when it rains.

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Buster is a cute and cheeky little bus with an adventurous spirit and an inquisitive mind. More than anything else, he loves exploring his high-tech hometown Wheelieville, riding into adventures both big and small with his vehicle friends The Bumper Bunch.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Gather round for storytime! Jeff gets a new book but doesnt want to share it with the other Minibods. Newt finds an injured Oddfrog and tries to nurse it back to health. Bubbles gets stage fright before a big show and has to find her confidence. She also finds a giant bubble and tries to take it home without it popping.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Get ready for a teddy bear panic! Pogo accidentally ruins Newts special teddy bear-shaped hedge and isnt sure if he should tell the truth. Jeff has to overcome his fear of mud to get his favorite feather duster back. Bubbles wants to take a picture with a big purple star and builds a rocket to get to it. Pogo tries to surprise his friends with ice cream, but it keeps melting.

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: JJ is having a dance party and youre invited! Dance and countdown with five little dinosaurs, then see how fast you can sing Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes. Visit a pumpkin patch, dance among the stars and help solve the mystery of Who Took the Cookie. Sing about the Muffin Man, learn your vowels with Apples and Bananas, and express your joy in Italian!

programme.title: CoComelon

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a day of nursery rhyme adventures with his animal friends. First, help Mary find her little lamb, then sing about a black sheep with lots of wool. The fun ends with a clapping game all about a farm dog named BINGO. Its a charming story told through our favorite animal songs.

programme.title: Little World
programme.desc: Its time to learn your ABCs and how to count! Mom and Dad help the twins learn their letters with a fun caterpillar puzzle. They count colorful dinosaur toys and the babies on the slide at the playground. The friends also play with five little monkeys and when Nico gets sick, Nina is there to help him feel better.

programme.title: Little World
programme.desc: Its time to learn all about being healthy! The twins try some delicious fresh vegetables and learn that they are yummy. They go for a doctor check-up and even become doctors themselves to help their parents. They learn how to stay safe from mosquitos and the importance of washing their hands. Plus, they have a fun day swimming at the pool and the beach.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for bedtime with Mia. She says goodnight to all her toys and does some calming animal yoga. Daddy shows her how to brush her teeth with a fun dance. Twinkle helps make bath time a fun party. When her little brother cant sleep, Mia sings him a sweet lullaby. Plus, the moon and the stars fly over the town and say goodnight to everyone.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: As the day comes to a close, its time for Baby John to get ready for bed. This peaceful story follows his calming bedtime routine, from taking a warm bath and putting on his pajamas to listening to a sweet lullaby from his parents. Its a gentle journey that shows how a calm routine can lead to a wonderful nights sleep.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Its time to wind down with JJ. Follow his soothing bedtime routine, from taking a warm bath to brushing his teeth. As he looks out his window at the night sky, he sings Twinkle Twinkle Little Star before snuggling into bed for a sweet lullaby. Its a peaceful and relaxing journey into dreamland.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum: Lullabies
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much-loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

programme.title: Geckos Garage

They all come together, combining their different strengths and skills to help Gecko save the day. Its a powerful tale of community and friendship.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild arent as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Thornton Heath, South London, Inspector Nick Wheelhouse is called out to see three adult mastiffs and nine puppies who are all drastically underweight. Will Gaza, the mother and the skinniest of the dogs, be able to regain the weight she so desperately needs.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal peoples moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

Adelaida no cabe en si de la sorpresa cuando Hilario la busca para aclarar las cosas y, aunque al principio se muestra soberbio y la trata como a un objeto, termina arrodillado y admitiendo que no puede vivir sin ella.

A Caravaggio le parece que uno de los atractivos de Victoria es que no se deja impresionar por cualquiera, prueba de ello es que mando a investigar a Jack; la joven se interesa en saber que logro averiguar el periodista sobre el actor. programme.title: Corazon Traicionado - S01:E62
programme.desc: Alberto lleva a Ignacio al hospital para que sea atendido por el Dr. Olimpo, mientras continúa intentando contactar telefonicamente a Lorena. Sin conmiseracion alguna, Pedro asesina a sangre fría a Magda ante los ojos de Lorena.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E022
programme.desc: Hilario quiere que Victoria se olvide para siempre de Nicolás convencido de que el joven la está utilizando para vengarse de el. Leopoldo indaga con Nicolás quien es Florencia; el joven le revela que la muchacha es la hija del difunto capataz de Hilario. Nicolás se presenta en casa de Carmencita a pedirle a Victoria que no se deje convencer por Hilario; la muchacha admite que quiere estar con el, pero sabe que su relacion no es posible, por lo que le pide que le de un tiempo para pensar. Adelaida no cabe en si de la sorpresa cuando Hilario la busca para aclarar las cosas y, aunque al principio se muestra soberbio y la trata como a un objeto, termina arrodillado y admitiendo que no puede vivir sin ella.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E023
programme.desc: Clementina acusa sorpresa cuando Victoria le da a entender que va a darle a Builder la oportunidad de conquistarla; sin embargo, la joven Guanipa sigue añorando sus momentos de amor con Nicolás. Antonieta se aparta de Felipe pidiendole que entienda que no debe volverla a besar porque ella es una mujer comprometida; el joven quiere hacerle entender que Jonás no la merece e intenta besarla de nuevo. A Caravaggio le parece que uno de los atractivos de Victoria es que no se deja impresionar por cualquiera, prueba de ello es que mando a investigar a Jack; la joven se interesa en saber que logro averiguar el periodista sobre el actor. Adelaida se conmueve al leer la nueva carta que le entrega Hilario, quien indaga que más tiene que hacer para convencerla de lo que siente por ella.

programme.desc: Nicolás se pone celoso cuando Jonás le comenta que Jack invito a Victoria a jugar pool y que está seguro de que esa noche su amigo va a lograr besarla. Builder no se amilana ante las exigencias de Nicolás de que deje tranquila a Victoria y comienzan a discutir al punto que se caen a golpes hasta que la joven Guanipa y un mesonero los separan; Victoria le reclama a Del Casal su actitud posesiva con ella; el la besa con pasion para demostrarle que le da derecho a sentirse así. Eugenia llama a Yosmir para darle las gracias por la torta que le llevo cuando fue a visitarla; el aparte de reprocharle la forma en que lo trato frente a Fernanda, le dice lo que piensa de toda su familia logrando molestarla. Fernanda recibe una nota anonima donde le advierten que la estafa a Cantarrana no se va a quedar así y ella pagará por eso. Leopoldo advierte a Fernanda que está corriendo peligro, pero le asegura que el la va a proteger.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E03 - Operation Paddlefish
programme.desc: 執法者在捉到一些鹿角偷獵者後遇到了一群人，打擊試圖在鰻魚季節作弊的漁民，一名執法者處理一群熱鬧的露營者。

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E05 - Soaked Spirits
programme.desc: R.L. shares with Casey about the tough times that helped him understand why Be Alive matters so much. Chris and Kaid are stuck in the tent because of the harsh Alaskan weather. Meanwhile, Casey and R.L. manage to find some food.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E06 - Bearing Down
programme.desc: As they were having dinner, Casey noticed a bear wandering on the hill. Both he and R.L. sprinted through the rain, trying to get closer. Meanwhile, Chris was getting fed up with staying in the tent.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:05 - 3 in 1 Day
programme.desc: Para Jess, la vida en casa parece fuera de control. Sin embargo, la rutina de trabajo está controlada, incluso cuando el equipo se enfrenta a tres rescates sin precedentes en menos de doce horas.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E06 - Bombs Away
programme.desc: Jamie confía en la nueva tecnología de explosivos para mantener seguras las pistas de esquí y abiertas las carreteras locales durante todo el invierno. Pero su bombardeo de bombas antiavalanchas no basta para salvar a todo el mundo.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E07 - Legends of Buried Treasure
programme.desc: Stanton Arizona es famosa por su historia de minas de oro, incluida la leyenda del tesoro enterrado de Charles Stanton, ¡y Tom tiene una corazonada!

programme.title: Carters W.A.R. - S01:E09 - Man and Man Eaters
programme.desc: Ivan Carter descubre la verdad sobre lo que ocurre cuando leones y humanos conviven en África.

programme.title: Diana: In Search of Happiness
programme.desc: 體驗對戴安娜公主的深入了解，這位20世紀的非凡女性。包含獨特的訪談和感人的片段，這幅肖像捕捉了她通往名聲的驚人之旅，以及她克服幾乎每天遭遇的情感和身體挑戰的能力。

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E04 - Operation Justice
programme.desc: A five-year-old poaching case finally wraps up, and a grizzly bear has the wardens on high alert. Afterward, the wardens gather in Helena for their yearly meet-up and have a bit of fun.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E07 - High Water
programme.desc: 克里斯和凱德被困在帳篷裡幾天，當天氣變好時，終於得到了一段休息。他們意識到降雨導致河流上升至危險水平。儘管如此，他們的獵尋大動物之旅依然持續。

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E08 - Moose Fever
programme.desc: 克里斯和凱德正在追蹤一頭巨大的雄駝鹿，凱德準備開槍。與此同時，凱西和R.L.仍在尋找大型獵物。河水位依然高峻且狂野。

programme.desc: A medida que su aventura en Alaska llega a su fin, Kaid y R.L. reflexionan sobre lo que realmente cuenta en la vida y lo que han descubierto sobre vivir. Los lazos de toda la vida son más fuertes que nunca mientras se preparan para dejar Alaska.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E01 - Terrys Criminal Mind
programme.desc: 這是一段範例描述。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E02 - Shark Go Boom!
programme.desc: In Jaws, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a giant shark on a motorized platform to test if you can hit, and explode, the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E01 - From There to Here
programme.desc: Con el reciente lanzamiento de la primera nave espacial privada que prestará servicio a la estacion espacial internacional, ha llegado el momento de echar un nuevo vistazo a las nuevas fronteras del espacio. El cielo está plagado de estrellas e innumerables galaxias. Con la robotica, las tecnologías avanzadas y la audacia, estamos llegando a donde antes solo soñábamos.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E02 - Return To The Moon
programme.desc: La Luna, nuestra compañera celeste más cercana. Nuestra indispensable pareja de baile a traves del cosmos. Iluminando nuestro cielo nocturno y tirando suavemente de nuestras costas. Pocos han caminado sobre su superficie, aunque su encanto sigue siendo fuerte, una vez más miramos hacia ella con renovado interes y con la intencion de volver muy pronto.

programme.title: Carters W.A.R. - S02:E01 - At All Costs
programme.desc: Ivan emprende un viaje para salvar a los diecinueve rinocerontes de su amigo de la epidemia de caza furtiva que azota Sudáfrica. La solucion: la pesadilla logística de transportar a toda la manada a un lugar seguro a 600 millas al otro lado del país.

programme.title: Harry And Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle dan Putera Harry berkongsi minat yang serupa dan nampak seperti pasangan yang sempurna. Keduanya telah menghadapi masa sukar semasa membesar tetapi telah berjaya. Kini mereka sedang berjaya bersama. programme.title: Home for a Royal Heart

programme.title: Lies My Babysitter Told
programme.desc: Carnie決定重返工作，最終雇用了鄰居的兒子Matt來照顧她的2歲孩子。她的丈夫Nick對這個主意不太高興。沒過多久，一個秘密浮出水面。

programme.title: Falling for the Competition
programme.desc: Molly runs the local moms group and this year theyre entering the prestigious Modern Parenting Group of the Year Contest. When a new to town dad, Ashley, sets up a rival dads group, their competitive natures cause competition in town.

programme.title: Home for a Royal Heart
programme.desc: When the seaside town of Shaw Bay is under threat of a redevelopment, realtor Erin will do anything to save it. Cue the handsome Theo, a royal looking for a new property. The catch is, hes hiding the royal part.

programme.title: Threats From The Inside
programme.desc: 布拉德·柯林斯對妻子的愛變成了佔有慾，變得越來越控制。當他懷疑她有外遇時，發生了一場導致悲劇的激烈爭吵。

programme.title: My Two Husbands
programme.desc: 布魯克正在管理與她的高中甜心斯特凡和她的富有年長丈夫丹恩的婚姻。與此同時，她和斯特凡正在設計如何獲得一些現金。當丹恩的女兒伊莉莎即將揭露他們的陰謀時，情況變得複雜。布魯克對整個計劃開始產生第二次想法，似乎一場重大的對抗即將來臨。

programme.title: Killer Cover Up
programme.desc: 全明星足球運動員珍娜·西姆斯和她的母親莎莉準備在搬到新陽光海灘城鎮後，迎接新的開始。但當她新足球隊的其他成員開始接連死亡，而其中一人落入昏迷之中時，珍娜發現自己被指控為兇手。

programme.title: Here Kills the Bride
programme.desc: Inspired by the Highly Acclaimed Thriller - The Perfect Bride – Jessica is shocked to find out that her brother, Carlos, is getting married in a week to Grace, a girl he just met in a strip club, something he would never regularly do. Determined to find out the real reasons behind the marriage, Jessica gets pulled into a whirlwind of events, putting her own life at risk. Is Carlos in trouble? Or is Grace a victim?

programme.title: Killer Cover Up
programme.desc: 全明星足球運動員珍娜·西姆斯和她的母親莎莉準備在搬到新陽光海灘城鎮後，迎接新的開始。但當她新足球隊的其他成員開始接連死亡，而其中一人落入昏迷之中時，珍娜發現自己被指控為兇手。

programme.title: Love on the Reef
programme.desc: A smart and serious marine biologist and a fun-loving and laissez-faire dive instructor must team up to save their beloved reef from being destroyed before its too late.

programme.title: The Story of Love
programme.desc: Ruby，一位有抱負的浪漫小說作家，為了獲得有利可圖的書籍合約，參加了她的文學英雄和當下最熱門作家Marcus Harlow在塔霍主持的一個寫作研討會。但當戶外型酒店老闆Woody向她展示大自然的美麗時，Ruby開始懷疑自己是否寫了錯誤的故事來打動像Marcus這樣的人。

programme.title: Pocket Dial Murder
programme.desc: 故事跟隨史黛西，她接到丈夫的誤撥電話。在電話的另一頭，她聽到一名女子的死訊。當她丈夫回家時，他說他的手機不見了。

programme.title: Dare to Say Yes
programme.desc: 米歇爾正度過最糟糕的一天——同一天被解雇並被甩。最好的朋友莎拉說服她去参加一個新的靜修會，該靜修會提供一個名為勇敢說是的健康和賦權計劃。

programme.title: My Killer Reunion
programme.desc: 克莱尔和詹姆斯是一对已婚夫妇，他们前往医学院校友会，与老同学摩根重聚。然而，摩根迷恋詹姆斯，决心要将他占为己有，试图在此过程中破坏克莱尔的生活。

programme.title: A Royal Makeover
programme.desc: When Ramone discovers he is the heir to the European Kingdom of San Pablo, he is daunted by the prospect of becoming king. Royal expert Angelica is hired to transform Ramone into the king he is destined to be.

programme.title: Snowkissed
programme.desc: 一位不喜愛旅行的記者追逐她夢寐以求的任務，在那裡她很快就成為一位渴望成為導遊的英俊BAndB業主的導師。

programme.title: A View to Kill For
programme.desc: 莫莉和她的家人繼承了她遙遠父親的豪宅後，搬到了高尚的社區。然後，有人闖入並在他們的牆上塗寫了一個可怕的消息。

programme.title: Our Mothers Secret Affair
programme.desc: 黛安娜·帕克發現她家中的入侵者實際上是她的親生女兒，幾年前她將其交給了領養。當他們努力重建彼此的關係時，他們遇到了一個危險的威脅 - 一個無情的殺手，將不惜一切代價阻止他們重聚，即使這意味著謀殺。

programme.title: Lies My Babysitter Told
programme.desc: Carnie決定重返工作，最終雇用了鄰居的兒子Matt來照顧她的2歲孩子。她的丈夫Nick對這個主意不太高興。沒過多久，一個秘密浮出水面。

programme.title: A Deadly Mistake
programme.desc: 平面設計師四月發生車禍，讓她的男友派屈克陷入昏迷，她因此受到恐慌發作的折磨。但她的新男性朋友是否有隱藏的企圖？

programme.title: Danger Rocks the Cradle
programme.desc: Nicolette, a high school senior has bounced around from foster home to home. She started feeling hopeless when found herself pregnant by the school quarterback.

programme.title: Kidnapped to the Island
programme.desc: 一位渴望成為流行歌手的星粉少女失踪，她關心的單親媽媽出發拯救她，免遭那位引誘她來遙遠小島的控制性歌手的掌控，該歌手以名聲和財富為誘惑。

programme.title: The Love Advisor
programme.desc: Abby works as an assistant and writer of the popular podcast run by her former college friend Serena. Journalist comes from NYC to write about podcast and Serena. Abby starts to develop feelings, but Serena already has a plan for herself.

programme.title: The Wedding Contest
programme.desc: 當一對夫婦無法決定婚禮主題時，他們雇了兩位婚禮策劃師，泰勒和本，讓他們透過提出兩種截然不同的風格來競爭這份工作。

programme.title: E1 - S02:E13 - E1-Weltmeisterschaft in Miami
